layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video matting, the task of extracting foreground objects

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with pixel-level precision from video, serves as a fundamen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tal component in video editing applications, including back-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ground replacement [6, 32, 51], visual composition [3, 48],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and relighting [2, 32, 43].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Despite its importance, training a video matting model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that performs robustly across diverse real-world videos re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mains challenging for two key reasons. First, high-quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting annotations are extremely scarce. Ground-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: truth mattes are typically captured in controlled environ-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ments such as chroma key studios [26, 52] or with special-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ized camera setups [5], which makes it difficult to scale an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: notation efforts and to capture diverse objects, scenes, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: camera angles. As a result, existing datasets are often lim-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ited to human portraits.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Second, most video matting models are trained on syn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thetic videos, where foregrounds are composited onto arbi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trary backgrounds. Such synthetic compositions often intro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: duce unrealistic artifacts in lighting, motion blur, and tem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: poral coherence. These two factors, limited data diversity

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and the domain gap between synthetic and real videos, sig-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nificantly hinder the ability of current models to generalize

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to real-world footage where complex interactions between

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foregrounds and backgrounds naturally occur.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this work, we propose a novel bootstrapping strat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: egy that effectively bridges the gap between synthetic and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: real-world videos, enabling more robust video matting. We

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: introduce Video Mask-to-Matte Model (VideoMaMa), a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diffusion-based model that converts binary segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: masks into continuous alpha mattes (see Figure 1). Built

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: upon pretrained video diffusion models [1], VideoMaMa

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: demonstrates remarkable zero-shot generalization to real-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: world videos, even though the model is trained exclusively

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on synthetic data. This strong generalization ability stems

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from diffusion priors trained on internet-scale image and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video data, which can generate high-quality content across

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diverse domains [1, 9, 42]. To adapt these priors for video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting while preserving their generative capabilities, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: introduce a two-stage training strategy that separately op-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: timizes spatial and temporal layers, along with semantic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: knowledge injection via DINOv3 [39] features.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To evaluate the robustness of the VideoMaMa model,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we conduct experiments on video matting guided by binary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: masks from diverse sources, including those produced by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: existing video segmentation models. The results show that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: VideoMaMa consistently generates high-quality video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting outputs regardless of the input mask type, demonstrat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing strong robustness. These findings suggest that Video-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: MaMa can be effectively utilized as a pseudo-labeler for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constructing large-scale video matting annotations.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In addition, by leveraging VideoMaMa, we propose a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: simple but scalable pipeline for constructing large-scale

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting annotations and introduce the Matting Any-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thing in Videos (MA-V) dataset, the first large-scale pseudo

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting dataset built by converting segmentation la-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bels from the SA-V dataset [31]. Unlike existing video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting datasets [8, 14, 26, 49, 52], which rely on synthetic or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: composited content, MA-V provides high-quality matting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: annotations for over 50K real-world videos covering diverse

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scenes, objects, and motion dynamics, as summarized in Ta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ble 1. This scalable pipeline demonstrates the potential of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: leveraging generative priors and segmentation labels, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are considerably easier to obtain than video alpha matte, to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: efficiently construct large-scale, high-quality video matting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To validate the effectiveness of large-scale pseudo video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting annotations, we fine-tune the SAM2 [31] model for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting using MA-V, referred to as SAM2-Matte.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Trained without any architectural modifications, the SAM2-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Matte model achieves substantially more robust matting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance on in-the-wild videos than the same SAM2

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model fine-tuned on existing video matting datasets, as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: well as other existing video matting methods. The results

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: demonstrate the strong potential of large-scale pseudo an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: notations to drive advancements in video matting research.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our contributions can be summarized as follows.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • VideoMaMa: A diffusion-based model that generates re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alistic video matting annotations from binary masks, en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: abling scalable matting label creation with easily obtain-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: able segmentation labels.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • MA-V Dataset: The first large-scale, high-quality video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting dataset built on real captured footage, consisting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of over 50K diverse videos.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video matting. Video matting methods can be catego-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rized into auxiliary-free and auxiliary-guided approaches.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Auxiliary-free methods [16, 25, 27] typically focus on por-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trait matting, restricting their applicability to human-centric

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scenarios. Trimap-guided approaches [13, 37] require man-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ual trimap annotations, limiting their practicality for zero-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: shot inference. Recent mask-based guidance methods ad-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dress these limitations: MaGGIe [14] decouples tracking

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from matting using binary mask tracks, MatAnyone [49]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: propagates target-assigned matting through a memory-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: augmented architecture, and GVM [8] employs diffusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models for portrait matting. Despite these advances, ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: isting methods remain constrained by domain specificity.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Beyond algorithmic limitations, existing datasets also

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constrain progress. Representative datasets include Video-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Matte240K [26] (484 videos), VideoMatting108 [52] (108

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: videos), and VM800 [49] (826 videos), predominantly fo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cusing on human subjects in controlled settings [8, 40, 45].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Critically, all rely on composition-based generation where

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foreground objects are composited onto random back-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: grounds, creating artificial scene compositions. No large-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scale real video matting dataset exists where foreground and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: background naturally co-occur.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Diffusion models for perception tasks. Recent advances

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have demonstrated that diffusion models [1, 20, 34, 42] en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: code rich priors about natural scenes, motion dynamics, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: temporal coherence. Marigold [15] pioneered this direc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion by finetuning Stable Diffusion for monocular depth es-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: timation, achieving strong zero shot generalization despite

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training only on synthetic data. This success has extended

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to semantic segmentation [44, 53] and video depth estima-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion [11, 38]. These models exhibit remarkable zero shot

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generalization across perception tasks [7, 10, 11, 46, 53],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: maintaining strong performance on real data even when

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained exclusively on synthetic data, suggesting they can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bridge the synthetic to real domain gap. For matting, SD-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Matte [12] applies diffusion models to interactive image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting, while GVM [8] focuses on portrait video matting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with emphasis on hair details. However, these methods are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: limited to either single images or specific domains like hu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: man portraits, lacking the scale and generality needed for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diverse video matting scenarios.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Pseudo-label generation in segmentation/matting has

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: become a key driver of recent progress. In the Segment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Anything Model [19, 31], the authors demonstrated that it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is possible to create an iterative self-training loop by build-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing a strong segmentation model and bootstrapping it with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: its own outputs. ZIM [17] trained a converter model that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transforms image binary masks into alpha mattes using ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: isting image matting datasets.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Inspired by the recent successes, we address video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting, which presents distinct challenges. Unlike image mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting [21, 23, 24, 35] and video object segmentation, where

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: abundant manually annotated ground-truth data [4, 29, 31,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 47] enables training strong labeler models, video matting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets remain scarce and predominantly synthetic. This

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: limitation hinders model generalization to real-world sce-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: narios. To overcome the challenge, we exploit the genera-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive priors of pre-trained video diffusion models and train

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a robust pseudo-labeler using small-scale synthetic video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting annotations.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3. Video Mask-to-Matte Model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1. Problem Formulation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video matting is mathematically defined by the alpha com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: positing equation,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: , where I is the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: observed image, F is the foreground, B is the background,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is the alpha matte representing pixel-level

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: opacity. Unlike binary segmentation masks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: , al-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pha mattes capture fine-grained details such as hair strands,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: motion blur, and intricate regions, which are critical for re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alistic video compositing.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: There are several ways to specify the target object in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and guide masks are processed through video diffusion U-Net lay-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ers to generate high-quality video mattes. Semantic injection with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DINO features is applied during training.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting. One approach is to predefine the target se-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mantic class, for example human portraits [8, 21], while an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: other is to condition the model on additional signals such as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: points, boxes, or masks [12, 14, 50].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We adopt binary segmentation masks as conditioning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: signals for two critical reasons: (1) masks allow the diffu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sion model to focus solely on generating fine-grained mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting details (e.g., hair strands, motion blur) rather than infer-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ring object boundaries, since shape information is already

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: provided by the mask. This design decouples the chal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lenges of object localization and matte generation, making

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the pipeline more robust and generalizable and (2) Finally,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: since binary masks can be obtained through various sources,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the applicability of a model can be greatly expanded. In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: this paper, we demonstrate that VideoMaMa can not only

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: perform video matting in various settings when combined

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with existing video segmentation models, but also enables

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the conversion of existing video segmentation datasets into

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting datasets.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.2. Architecture Design

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We build VideoMaMa on top of Stable Video Diffusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (SVD) [1], a pretrained video diffusion model originally de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: signed for image-to-video generation. By leveraging gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ative priors, it can generate high-quality video matting an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: notations that exhibit realistic characteristics such as natural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: motion blur, proper edge detail, and temporal consistency,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effectively transferring the model's learned understanding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of video dynamics to the matting task.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We adapt the SVD architecture for mask-guided video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting by introducing mask-based conditioning in the la-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tent space and employing single-step inference for im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proved efficiency. In addition, we propose a semantic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: knowledge injection technique that enhances the model's

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: understanding of object boundaries and strengthens tem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: poral consistency when tracking complex objects with fine

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structural details. An overview of the model is shown in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 2.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Latent space formulation. Following modern video dif-

layout_dets.text: 3.3. Training Recipe

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Mask augmentation. While providing binary masks as in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: put conditioning signals simplifies the task for the diffusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model, it also introduces the risk of copy-paste behavior.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: For objects with simple shapes (e.g., cars or desks) or masks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pha mattes), the model may trivially copy the mask instead

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of generating realistic matting details by reasoning about

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the RGB image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To prevent this, we apply mask augmentation during

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training to remove fine-grained information from the in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: put masks, forcing the model to infer matting details from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the RGB image. Our mask augmentation strategy consists

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of two operations (see Figure 3): (1) Polygonization: We

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approximate the mask boundary with a polygon, simplify-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the contour and removing fine details. (2) Downsam-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ple degradation: We downsample and upsample the mask at

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strong augmentation levels.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the same scale, which effectively removes high-frequency

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: details while preserving the overall shape. These augmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tations create a gap between the coarse input mask and the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fine-grained target alpha matte, encouraging the model to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: leverage appearance cues from the RGB video to generate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: realistic matting details.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Two-stage training. For matting tasks, both training and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inference resolution are critical. As matting operates at the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel level with continuous values, downsampling to lower

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resolutions can degrade fine-grained matting details. How-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ever, training video diffusion models at high resolution is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: computationally prohibitive. To address this challenge, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: propose a two-stage training strategy that decomposes the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learning process: first training spatial layers at high resolu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion on single frames to capture fine details, then training

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: temporal layers at lower resolution on video sequences to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learn temporal consistency. In the first stage, we freeze the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: temporal layers of SVD and train only the spatial layers,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enabling the model to focus on capturing pixel-level details

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: at high resolution. While this stage allows the model to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learn fine-grained features within individual frames, it lacks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: temporal consistency across video sequences. In the second

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stage, we freeze the spatial layers to preserve the learned

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detail-capturing capability and fine-tune only the temporal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: layers to learn temporal coherence and video-specific char-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: acteristics. This decomposed training strategy enables our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model to achieve both high-resolution detail and tempo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ral consistency without requiring full high-resolution video

layout_dets.text: training.

layout_dets.text: 5. Experiments

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 5.1. Experimental Details

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Implementation details. We train VideoMaMa based on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the Stable Video Diffusion [1] (SVD) model using diverse

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image and video matting datasets. Our two-stage training

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strategy employs different resolutions optimized for each

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stage's objective. In stage 1, we train the spatial layers of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SVD on single images at high resolution (1024×1024) to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: capture fine-grained matting details such as hair strands and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: intricate boundary structures. We freeze the temporal layers

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: during this stage to focus learning on spatial precision. In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stage 2, we freeze the learned spatial layers and train only

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the temporal layers on video sequences. To balance compu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tational efficiency with temporal modeling, we use 3-frame

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: clips at 704×704 resolution, which enables the model to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learn temporal consistency and motion-aware matting char-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: acteristics. To inject semantic knowledge, we incorporate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features from a frozen DINOv3 [39] encoder, aligning the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DINO features with the first upsampling block of the SVD

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoder. This integration provides the diffusion model with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic understanding of object structures while preserv-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing its generative capabilities.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Training details. For both stages, we use a batch size of 64

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and a learning rate of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with the AdamW optimizer.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The training objective,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: combines L1 loss for pixel-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: wise accuracy and Laplacian loss for preserving edge sharp-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ness and boundary details. Each stage is trained for 10,000

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: iterations until convergence. All experiments are conducted

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on NVIDIA A100 GPUs with mixed-precision training for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: efficiency. SAM2-Matte is trained on the combination of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: existing video matting datasets and MA-V. Details of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: existing datasets are provided in the appendix.

layout_dets.text: 6. Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We introduce VideoMaMa, a diffusion-based model that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: leverages generative priors to perform robust video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting. By exploiting VideoMaMa's strong generalization ca-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pability, we construct MA-V, the first large-scale pseudo

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting dataset built on real-world videos, by con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: verting segmentation masks from SA-V. Through compre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hensive experiments, we demonstrate that both VideoMaMa

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and models trained on MA-V (e.g., SAM2-Matte) achieve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: state-of-the-art performance across diverse video matting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of our data gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eration approach. We believe that VideoMaMa and MA-V

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: will significantly contribute to advancing video matting re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: search by providing both a VideoMaMa and a large-scale,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-quality dataset that bridges the synthetic-to-real do-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: main gap.
